purpose: Concrete, executable readiness spec for ingesting genuinely new real feeds with provenance. No data is fabricated. If a feed cannot be ingested with verifiable provenance, it remains blocked_no_real_feed.

feeds.hypothesis_pre_stated: Perpetual funding/basis carry (or cross-maturity basis) yields net-of-funding-and-cost OOS PnL after benchmark/carry costs on overlapping WF windows with the cached spot universe.

real_sources_acceptable.notes: Public; respect rate limits; capture request URLs, params, retrieval timestamp, and response hashes.
Only if operator can retrieve with provenance; symbol mapping must be explicit.

dtypes.timestamp_utc: ISO8601 UTC string or tz-aware datetime64[ns, UTC]

target_schema.alignment: Resample/align to 1h grid consistent with spot cache when joined; document any interpolation (prefer none/forward-fill only if justified and recorded).

fail_closed_loader_requirements: Refuse load if .meta.json missing or sha256_pkl mismatch.
Refuse if timestamp gaps exceed declared tolerance without explicit gap record.
Refuse if funding_rate contains impossible sentinel values not documented.
No proxy: do not synthesize funding from spot returns or volatility.
cost_carry_model_inputs: spot/perp trading fees+slippage bps (use repo cost grid where applicable)
funding received/paid per interval using actual funding_rate series
basis carry only if real futures/perp price series with provenance present
inventory/margin constraints documented as assumptions (not fabricated data)
validation_checks: Cross-check a sample of timestamps/rates against provider UI/docs (recorded in meta).
Verify symbol coverage overlaps cached spot (BTC/ETH/SOL minimum).
Run WF 720/168/168 net-of-cost-and-funding; report per-slice and aggregate; benchmark B&H.
ingestion_runbook_operator: 1) Choose provider (Binance fapi recommended) and symbols (BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT,SOLUSDT,...) covering cached spot.
2) Retrieve historical funding (and optional mark/index) for 2026-04-01..2026-10-30 UTC (or maximal overlap). Save raw responses to a temp dir outside commit if large; compute hashes.
3) Normalize to target_schema; write .pkl and .meta.json into data/cache/ with naming convention; compute sha256_pkl and embed in meta.
4) Run validation_checks and a dry-run loader that enforces fail_closed_loader_requirements.
5) Commit only small provenance/meta + deterministic artifacts; do not commit secrets/API keys; large raw dumps only if repo policy allows and provenance preserved.
6) Re-run Path R: produce *_costed_oos_<UTC>.json + real_feed_unblock_status_<UTC>.json + strategy_edge_registry_<UTC>.json.

feeds.hypothesis_pre_stated: Same-asset price dislocation between two real venues yields net-of-fees/slippage/transfer-latency-adjusted OOS edge on synchronized windows.

real_sources_acceptable.notes: Two independent real venues for same asset (e.g., BTC). Must include venue identifiers and synchronized timestamps.

target_schema.alignment: Strict timestamp alignment; drop/mask misaligned bars fail-closed with counts recorded.

fail_closed_loader_requirements: Refuse if either venue provenance missing or fabricated.
Refuse if alignment produces ambiguous joins; no interpolation of missing venue prices.
No proxy: do not use a single venue as 'dual'.
cost_carry_model_inputs: taker/maker fees per venue (documented assumption) + slippage bps grid
transfer/latency modeled as explicit cost/holding constraint (assumptions recorded, not fabricated ticks)
validation_checks: Verify dislocation distribution is plausible; spot-check samples vs public charts (recorded).
WF net-of-cost OOS; edge proven only if survives all cost slices and beats benchmark.
ingestion_runbook_operator: 1) Select asset(s) overlapping cache (BTC/ETH/SOL) and two venues with public historical data.
2) Retrieve OHLC/close series for identical windows/freq; record endpoints+hashes.
3) Align timestamps; write dualvenue .pkl+.meta.json with provenance; sha256 verify.
4) Run costed WF evaluation (Path R artifact) with explicit fee/latency assumptions.

feeds.hypothesis_pre_stated: Real implied-vol term structure / surface signals (not fabricated) produce net-of-cost OOS edge (e.g., carry/relative-value) under WF protocol.

endpoints_examples: public get_historical_volatility or DVOL history; options instruments history if available with provenance
real_sources_acceptable.notes: Must be actual IV/surface data; README states CLI does not fabricate iv_30d/iv_90d.

fail_closed_loader_requirements: Refuse if iv columns missing or fabricated (see README term-structure note).
No proxy from realized vol labeled as IV.
cost_carry_model_inputs: Options/vol instrument trading costs/slippage assumptions documented; if not tradable in-repo, report signal-only with fail-closed 'not_executable' flag.
validation_checks: WF net-of-cost OOS with benchmark; pre-state entry/exit.
ingestion_runbook_operator: 1) Retrieve real IV/DVOL history for BTC/ETH from Deribit (or equivalent) with timestamps.
2) Normalize to target schema; write .pkl+.meta.json with full provenance/hashes.
4) Run costed WF backtest; produce Path R artifacts or mark not_executable if costs unmodelable.

feeds.hypothesis_pre_stated: Real intrabar/tick/trade/book microstructure yields net-of-cost OOS edge beyond 1h spot close strategies.

real_sources_acceptable.notes: High volume; may be impractical in CI environment. Only ingest with verifiable raw provenance.

fail_closed_loader_requirements: Refuse without provenance+hash; refuse fabricated/synthetic flags.
No resampling to 1h presented as microstructure edge.
cost_carry_model_inputs: fees+slippage+latency assumptions explicit; spread/impact modeled only from real book/trades if present
validation_checks: Timestamp monotonicity, outlier checks, sample cross-verification.
ingestion_runbook_operator: 1) Assess feasibility (size/rate limits). Retrieve bounded sample window with provenance.
3) Only then run Path R costed WF; otherwise remain blocked.

oos_edge_proven_true_only_if: all pre-stated cost-grid slices have OOS net > 0
beats benchmark on same WF windows (pre-stated)
global_acceptance_criteria_for_path_R.if_provenance_missing: Do not claim ingestion; produce Path C-maintain artifacts and keep family blocked_no_real_feed.
